newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-TELERJ STILL A BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-TELERJ STILL A BUY.

text.p: ING Barings said it reiterated its buy on Brazilian telecoms operator Telerj, a unit of federal holding Telebras serving Rio de Janeiro state.

-- ING Barings analyst Vera Rossi said in a report that the rating was maintained with a 12-month target price of $185.50 per 1,000 shares based on substantial plant increase and network improvement at Telerj.
-- The target price indicates a potential total return of 21 percent, she said.
-- Rossi also said second-quarter Telerj earnings of 15.6 million reais were 64 percent below a forecast of 43 million reais and off 49 percent quarter-on-quarter.
-- The main reason was that local revenue was 16.7 percent lower estimated and local usage was 12 percent below lower than estimates, she added.
-- "We believe Telerj will start to show improvement in earnings during second-half 1997 and 1998," she wrote.
-- Telerj common was up 1.57 percent at 162.52 reais, while its preferred was 2.65 percent higher at 174 reais at 1258 local/1158 edt/1558 gmt in Sao Paulo.
